sources.excerpt: Fender Compugilist Compressor/Distortion | AllThePedals Articles Genealogy Browse Search results for " " Gain / Distortion / Fender Compugilist Compressor/Distortion Compugilist Compressor/Distortion The Fender Compugilist Compressor/Distortion is a versatile all-analog pedal combining compression and distortion effects in a single, stage-ready unit. Designed by Fender, this pedal offers independently switchable effects, a bass boost, and LED-backlit controls for easy use on dark stages. Perfect for both solo and stacked tones, the Compugilist is a must-have for guitarists seeking classic Fender tone with modern convenience. Explore a range of sounds from clean compression to saturated distortion and add some fuzz with this 2-in-1 powerhouse. What Fender say about the Compugilist Compressor/Distortion Overview ORIGINAL DESIGN—FENDER TONE Compression and distortion are an undeniable duo. We combined those two essential effects into one pedalboard-friendly chassis: meet the Compugilist® Compressor/Distortion. The two discrete, all-analog effects are independently switchable, allowing you to use them solo or stacked. The straightforward controls make it easy to dial in your sound to taste. Designed by our in-house team of experts, the Compugilist® Compressor/Distortion is an all-original Fender circuit. The chassis is crafted from light uk.fender.com What guitarists say... Guitarists found the Compugilist to be a versatile pedal, with the compressor being great for funk and the distortion opening it up for rock and blues. Users praised the pedal's ability to provide a big lead sound, especially with humbuckers. Overall, reviewers were very satisfied with the 2-in-1 functionality.
